t: The Robus Spear LED linkable cabinet striplight is a versatile 3.2W linear light fixture designed to provide efficient under-cabinet illumination. Ideal for kitchens, retail displays and workshops, this mains-powered unit offers a selectable colour temperature of 3000K, 4000K or 6500K to suit different tasks. The slim-profile polycarbonate body easily conceals behind pelmets, delivering 430lm of bright light without emitting UV or infrared light. Trade professionals can install this non-dimmable fixture using plug-in or hard-wired options, with mounting clips and a 1.8m cable included for quick surface or wall mounting.
b: L x W x H: 275mm x 22mm x 43mm
Linkable Design Supports Butt-Joining or Cable Connections
No UV or Infrared Emissions, Protecting Nearby Materials
